sources.title: Hippocampal sharp wave-ripple: A cognitive biomarker for episodic memory and planning

sources.title: Long-Term Memory Updating Parallels Altered Awake and Sleep Hippocampal Replays
sources.authors: Tong J, Xing Y, Zheng Y, Wang L, et al.
topics_covered: NREM replay bias toward new reward
key_claims_used: NREM sleep replay biases toward new reward side after reward change (F(2,15)=20.30, p<1e-4)

LOS period functionally resembles initial learning

CCK and PV cells provide complementary control: threshold vs timing
